summary: A legal-heavy day driven by SEBI settlement of Adani disclosure cases and bail granted to ex-Reliance executive in ED proceedings, alongside India's stalled apparel export competitiveness despite China's decline.

bullets.text: SEBI settles Hindenburg-linked disclosure cases against five Adani companies for ₹1.5 crore penalty.
Delhi High Court grants bail to ex-Reliance executive Amitabh Jhunjhunwala in ED case.
India's global apparel export share stuck at 3% in 2025 despite China losing market dominance; Bangladesh and Vietnam capturing China+1 shift.
India-New Zealand FTA ratified; comes into effect October 20.
B9 Beverages (Bira 91) seeks recapitalization; Anicut-led board offers to buy out key investors amid financial struggles.
